verdict.rationale: A offers the strongest price-and-convenience combination among the late-morning-return options, but it does not provide three contiguous seats. B and C cost more and are less convenient in some respects, yet each offers three adjacent seats, which can reasonably matter for a family traveling with a school-age child. The unknown pickup/ground-logistics preference between JFK and LGA also prevents a definitive choice between A and C. D is less plausible because its 12:10 p.m. Monday departure does not clearly fit the stated late-morning return window.
